title: 'Smuggled' cigarettes seized in Palimbang, Sultan Kudarat

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Acting on tips from concerned citizens, the Palimbang, Sultan Kudarat police confiscated P385,000 worth of smuggled cigarettes during law enforcement operations on Friday, October 16. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, director of Police Regional Office (PRO-12), said personnel from Palimbang municipal police station discovered the cigarette boxes stacked and partially covered with a tarpaulin beside an abandoned house in Sitio Bakung, Barangay Kulong-Kulong at about 11 p.m. In the presence of a barangay councilman, authorities did an inventory of the contraband, counting seven master cases of “Berlin” cigarettes and two master cases of “Fort.” Coordination through videoconference with the […]...
